answer: Commit-reveal beacon admission gates economy entry. Each applicant escrows a 10-unit velvet bond and files a commitment under a fresh codename such as sparrow or mesa before the beacon seed appears. After seed R appears, only applicants whose hash falls below a 1% admission cut may reveal and activate; unrevealed commitments forfeit the bond to a pool. An attacker buying N identities pays 10N in bonds, but each has a 1% activation chance, so expected seats equal 0.01N while forfeited bonds average 9.9N; scaling N multiplies locked capital, not influence.
